phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Three-sheet Riemann-surface geometry with inserted flux alpha.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The charged-moment construction is represented by an n-sheet Riemann surface threaded by an Aharonov-Bohm flux.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Schematic only; no quantitative verdict required.

phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Subsystem charge sectors are shown schematically.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: A generic many-body wavefunction decomposes into subsystem charge sectors relevant for symmetry-resolved entanglement.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Schematic only; no quantitative verdict required.

phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Definition of the charged Rényi moment with subsystem-number flux insertion.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The charged moment is s_n(alpha) = Tr rho_A^n exp(i alpha N_A).
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Evaluate the charged Rényi moment from the reduced density matrix and subsystem-number operator.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main text around Eq. explicitsn and discussion before Fig. 2
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: The charge distribution is given asymptotically as a Gaussian in Delta N_A with variance set by K ln L / pi^2.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The subsystem charge distribution P(N_A) is Gaussian with width controlled by K ln L / pi^2.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Compute the symmetry-resolved charge probabilities and compare them with the stated Gaussian asymptotics.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main text around Eq. (approx) and Fig. 2
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: The particle-number-resolved entanglement entropy follows the stated leading-log formula with Delta N_A dependence.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The charge-resolved entanglement entropy S(N_A) follows the reported logarithmic plus quadratic-in-Delta-N_A asymptotic form.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Evaluate S(N_A) from the symmetry-resolved moments and test the claimed asymptotic dependence.

phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Numerical and analytic charge distributions are compared for a half-filled tight-binding chain with L = 10000.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: For the L = 10000 half-filled tight-binding chain, the numerical charge distribution P(N_A) agrees with the analytical prediction without fitting parameters.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Generate P(N_A) numerically for the stated chain and compare it with the analytic formula.

phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Numerical and analytic charge-sector contributions to entanglement entropy are compared on the same system.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: For the same L = 10000 chain, the charge-sector entanglement contributions S(N_A) match the analytical prediction.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Compute symmetry-resolved entanglement entropy contributions and compare them with the analytic curve.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Eq. (11) and appendix discussion leading into Fig. 3
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: The integrated density of entanglement-spectrum levels resolved by charge is given by the stated CFT/Bessel-function form.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The charge-resolved integrated density n(lambda, N_A) obeys the analytical formula stated in Eq. (11).
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Evaluate the resolved integrated density of entanglement-spectrum eigenvalues and compare it to the analytic expression.

phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Charge-resolved entanglement-spectrum integrated densities are compared numerically and analytically for several N_A sectors.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: For several particle-number sectors, the numerical integrated density n(lambda, N_A) agrees with the CFT prediction shown in Fig. 3.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Construct n(lambda, N_A) for the specified system and compare sector-resolved curves with the analytic formula.

phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: The paper gives quantitative symmetry-resolved entanglement predictions for SU(2)_k multiplets.

phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Evaluate the SU(2)-resolved formulas and test the claimed symmetry-sector entropy relations.

phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Check the discrete-symmetry formulas and any stated numerical predictions for the critical-Ising / Z_N cases.
